rules.statement: All seizing creditors, including secondary and tertiary mortgagees, are entitled to share the money in deposit rateably so long as it has not been appropriated to a particular decree holder or holders by an order of that Court.
rules.supporting_quote: "The justice of the case requires-and that is the test laid down in the section-that all the seizing creditors, including the appellants, should share rateably."
